folderRef is the technical provider locator; folderPath is display metadata and must not drive local source traversal.
Source polling cadence, runtime cycle cadence and posting schedule are independent concerns.
Manual source scan and daemon polling share the same durable poll state and runtime-cycle lease.
A manual scan postpones the next interval poll across processes; last/next poll are durable workspace facts.
NEW_ONLY never infers newness from first observation time: it requires an explicit append-only SourceActivationBaseline captured before normal scanning.
NEW_ONLY baseline capture requires a previewed cursor fingerprint and previewed external-object snapshot; cursor or folder drift invalidates confirm.
No historical source file becomes new work without SourceActivationCursor semantics.
SourceActivationCursor is revisioned management configuration while SourceActivationBaseline is immutable runtime evidence.
Changed media fingerprint for the same source identity fails closed and can block the ContentAsset; it is never accepted as an in-place update.
Verified media cache reuse requires contentId, provider fingerprint, immutable sourceRef, local SHA and byte size to remain consistent.
Original user media is never modified or deleted by readiness, cache reuse or publishing.
A ContentAsset cannot become READY until repeated identical source observation, stable size and successful materialization/readability evidence exist.
Provider fingerprint remains source identity; materialized SHA-256 is readiness/upload evidence and does not silently replace source identity.
Cross-post content demand is source-position demand, not the sum of deliveries across targets.
OperatingCalendar chooses whether and which SchedulePolicy applies on a business date; it does not duplicate DistributionRoute.
Append-only DailyPlan history is audit-only; carry-over and delivery aggregation consume current DailyPlan heads exclusively.
Existing ScheduleReservation is a PlanningCommitment and cannot be silently replaced by replanning.
Drive defaults to database_only disposition and original media is not moved implicitly.
Every active DistributionRoute references an enabled lane, platform-compatible PostingProfile, CopyProfile and SchedulePolicy.
Missing content is explicit DailyPlanGap, never implicit silence.
Overflow is explicit backlog, never an automatic fifth publish.
Late arrivals follow an explicit policy; no missed slot is silently caught up.
Account slot, account daily-cap and account minimum-spacing conflicts are fail-closed plan gaps; route iteration order never selects a hidden winner.
PublicationIntent identity is deterministic from PlannedDelivery plus copy version.
DailyPlan route/profile/copy/schedule/source semantics are frozen as immutable provenance before any runnable PublicationIntent is created.
Route enabled means plan-visible, not execution-qualified; runnable intent requires current release/surface-scoped route evidence.
SECRET_LIVE has no generic Route Test Lab execution command and remains behind canonical PrivateE2E one-shot permit flow.
A schedule reservation transitions READY to SCHEDULED in the same durable transaction.
Required deliveries determine source completion; optional failures do not block completion unless configured required.
PUBLISH_UNCERTAIN is pending for DeliveryAggregate and remains reconciliation-only; it is never treated as failed or safe-to-retry by disposition.
External source mutation requires an explicitly registered adapter for the exact SourceConnection and mutation kind; missing adapters yield MANUAL_REVIEW.
ContentAsset becomes COMPLETE only after the selected SourceDisposition execution has been durably applied.
Same-day future configuration changes sharing one base revision are validated as an atomic change set and persisted by one config write; any invalid member keeps the whole set inactive.
Future configuration changes never auto-rebase across unrelated revision drift; drift produces NEEDS_REVIEW.
Immediate configuration changes never rewrite already committed deliveries.
Opening or closing a human login browser never marks SessionHealth HEALTHY; only a calibrated probe may record that evidence.
Each channel operator browser uses the account's isolated persistent BrowserIdentity profile and profile lease.
Control UI and admin notifications derive operational attention from the same current DailyPlan/read-model truth.
Every management mutation must show ConfigurationImpactReport or equivalent signed preview before apply.
A signed management preview may only be applied against the exact configuration revision it previewed; stale writes fail closed.
A new DistributionRoute invalidates future planning and requires route qualification even though it did not exist in the previous revision.
Management configuration enforces unique source, lane, profile, route and activation-cursor identities before write.
Normal success is quiet; notifications focus on action-required, warning, critical and summary states.
PUBLISH_UNCERTAIN remains reconciliation-only and cannot be resumed from UI.
Every feature change must be checked forward and backward across Source -> Route -> Plan -> UI -> Publish -> Verify -> Disposition -> Notification -> Recovery.
A commit message cannot be accepted as graph evidence; graph files themselves must contain the claimed version/state.
